defaultTarget.description: Target used when WORKSHOP_TARGET is unset.

extraFields.description: Product-specific workshop fields beyond the shared four. Each entry declares its type and the {{TOKEN}} that renders it, and the kit derives the TypeScript type, the customFields.workshop payload, the token map, and the known-token list for check:workshop-vars from this one place.

docsLabel.description: Footer Docs link label. Defaults to 'Workshop Docs'.

productSlug.description: Product slug used to derive codedApp.name as <productSlug>-<uipathTenantName> for any target that does not set one explicitly. Capped at 15 so the derived name fits the 32-character limit for typical tenant names.

baseUrl.description: Must start and end with a slash.

requiresTenantAccess.description: When true, build:target runs the advisory tenant-access check for this target. Left false, local and offline builds never touch a live tenant.

capacity.description: What this workshop needs from the tenant, used by check:tenant-access to turn raw quota numbers into a pass or a warning. Every field is optional and defaults to 0, which means "report the number without judging it" -- so a target that declares nothing still gets the readout, and only a target that states its needs can warn.

participants.description: Expected number of participants. Multiplies every per-participant figure below; leave unset and no threshold is applied.

aiUnitsPerParticipant.description: AI Units one participant is expected to burn across the whole workshop. Warns when account headroom is below participants x this.

agentUnitsPerParticipant.description: Agent Units one participant is expected to burn. Warns when account headroom is below participants x this.

ixpQuotaPerParticipant.description: Per-participant need for each IXP quota kind, keyed by the kind as `re get quotas` reports it (sources, datasets, buckets, comments, comments_per_source, integrations, triggers_per_dataset, extraction_predictions). The hard limits are discovered from the tenant, so only the need is declared here. A key the tenant does not report is warned about rather than ignored, since it is almost always a typo.

workshop.description: The four shared fields are required in every target. Fields declared in extraFields are additionally required, enforced by check:workshop-vars rather than by this schema.

name.description: Optional when the config sets productSlug: then it defaults to <productSlug>-<uipathTenantName>. An explicit value always wins, which is the escape hatch for tenant names too long to fit. Hard limit: uip codedapp deploy rejects names over 32 characters.
